attributes.name: Marhevok Wintersun
attributes.powers:
Before you act, summon and encounter the henchman Beverach.

If your check to defeat has the Attack or Ranged trait, the difficulty to defeat Marhevok is increased by 3.

If undefeated, Marhevok deals 1d4 Combat damage to each other character at your location.
